prompt:
Hand-drawn 2D game art for a side-on underground survival game. Clean, confident dark-brown ink linework of even weight, thicker on the outer silhouette and thinner inside, with slightly hand-made wobble. Flat colour fills with one crisp-edged shadow tone and one small highlight, lit evenly from the upper left. A faint paper-grain texture inside the fills only. Big simple shapes and generous plain areas; detail only where the eye should go. Muted, cold palette; warm colours only for fire, scarves and skin. In the spirit of Klei's Don't Starve and Oxygen Not Included and the flat graphic look of the Hilda animated series. Not photoreal, not 3D-rendered, no airbrushed gradients, no glow, no bloom, no rim light, no lens effects, no cast shadow on the ground, no background, no text.
Tobin, age40 gentle very broad stocky builder, about2.5 heads tall. Deep brown skin #8d5a3b, ginger bushy scalloped beard #b8642e, brown fur round trapper hat large earflaps #6b5440 dark leather crown #4a3628. Dot oval dark eyes tiny catchlight, no irises. Brown work coat #70553a sheepskin collar #d9cdb8, two patch pockets, tool belt measuring rope coil. Oversized mustard mittens #d1a23a, mustard scarf mostly hidden beard. Dark blue trousers #2f3b4a, huge brown boots. Torso about120px wide front, short coat hem y254, visible legs. Content small smile.
Use case: stylized-concept. Parts sheet for side view, the same character as the reference, same proportions, same colours. Reference is the turnaround. Exactly seven isolated parts in a strict 4-column by2-row grid. Top row: head, torso, trailing scarf tail only, near arm. Bottom row: far arm, near leg, far leg, EMPTY last cell.
Transparent background. Generous separation inside each equal grid cell, no parts crossing grid lines, no labels. All parts complete and rigid. Head eyes open, strict right-facing profile one eye with broad SOLID scarf/collar neck stub reaching down20px beyond chin so it overlaps coat; no bare gap. Torso no head, arms or legs; include scarf knot, collar top, coat hem and belt. Shoulders painted complete under arms, full coat and clothing intact. Arms straight down, rounded shoulder cap14px above pivot, cuffs and MITTENS not fingers. Legs straight, top rounded thigh cap14px above hip, trousers and boots. Far arm and far leg one shadow shade darker. Coat short; legs visibly separate.
